scene: You lace up skates and glide across to the departure docks.
picture: Side-view pixel art along a frozen dock line. On the far left, a glass-bottomed boat floats in slushy water. Centre left, the lanky boy balances on gleaming skates. Up high at centre, a colourful hot-air balloon bobs gently at a mooring post. On the far right, a brass propeller trolley sits on rails.
shown: a glass-bottomed boat bobbing beside an open ice canal on the left
a tethered hot-air balloon with an open wicker basket up high centre
